notes: Item 7 excerpt references a 'social commitment framework' and 'positive contributions to the communities where it operates' without specific programs, so it is treated as general language. The filing points to an annual Sustainability Report and sustainability.ovintiv.com, but Item 1 itself has a Human Capital section above 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Indigenous consultation (Blueberry River First Nation agreement) is a regulatory process, not a company program, and is not scored. Safety training is compliance training and reserves-evaluator training is narrow internal training; neither changes the Community score. The interns figure reflects recruitment into the company, so it is tagged employee_development rather than external_education.
